import json, sys
TID = sys.argv[1]
T='/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/skillberry-benchmarks/tau2/tau2-bench/data/tau2/domains/airline/tasks.json'
tasks={str(t['id']):t for t in json.load(open(T))}
task=tasks[TID]
print("="*80); print("TASK", TID)
print("--- description ---"); print(json.dumps(task.get('description'), indent=1))
print("--- user_scenario ---"); print(json.dumps(task.get('user_scenario'), indent=1))
print("--- evaluation_criteria (GOLD) ---"); print(json.dumps(task.get('evaluation_criteria'), indent=1))
d=json.load(open(f'trajectories/{TID}__seed__t0.json'))
print("--- SCORE feedback ---"); print(d['score']['feedback'])
print("="*80); print("TRACE")
for m in d['rollout']['trace']:
    role=m['role']; c=m.get('content'); tc=m.get('tool_calls')
    if c:
        print(f"\n[{role}] {c}")
    if tc:
        for call in tc:
            fn=call.get('function',call)
            name=fn.get('name'); args=fn.get('arguments')
            print(f"  >>CALL {name}({args})")
